question: Where is the nearest restaurant along the direction of travel from Sea Life Aquarium, San Antonio, TX to the Cross at Kerrville, Kerrville, TX?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.485816 29.424103)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-99.11422 30.074279)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.485816 29.424103)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.485816 29.424103)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Sea Life Aquarium, San Antonio, TX

[3].display_name: The Cross at Kerrville, Kerrville, TX
